package config

import "testing"

func TestOnboardingPathExecutionFeatureFlagDefaultsOffAndParsesExactly(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("PLANNER_ONBOARDING_PATH_EXECUTION_ENABLED", "")
	if enabled, err := boolean("PLANNER_ONBOARDING_PATH_EXECUTION_ENABLED", false); err != nil || enabled {
		t.Fatalf("default enabled=%t err=%v", enabled, err)
	}
	t.Setenv("PLANNER_ONBOARDING_PATH_EXECUTION_ENABLED", "true")
	if enabled, err := boolean("PLANNER_ONBOARDING_PATH_EXECUTION_ENABLED", false); err != nil || !enabled {
		t.Fatalf("explicit enabled=%t err=%v", enabled, err)
	}
	for _, invalid := range []string{"TRUE", "1", "yes"} {
		t.Setenv("PLANNER_ONBOARDING_PATH_EXECUTION_ENABLED", invalid)
		if _, err := boolean("PLANNER_ONBOARDING_PATH_EXECUTION_ENABLED", false); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted non-exact boolean %q", invalid)
		}
	}
}
